— You've never opened Meta Ads Manager

— You're applying to 50 jobs today with the same message

Lighthouse Inc. is a California-based digital marketing agency, and we're growing fast. We help small and medium-sized businesses get more leads through websites, paid ads, and automation, and right now we need another voice on the phones.

If you're a natural talker who isn't afraid to pick up the phone and turn a "no" into a "yes," keep reading.

The Job, in Plain Terms

You'll be calling US-based car repair shops and home service businesses on our behalf, working through provided lead lists to book appointments for our sales team. We're not looking for someone who just reads a script and hangs up. We want someone who listens, adapts, handles pushback, and actually enjoys the chase of getting someone to say yes to a meeting.

Hours align with California business time (8 AM to 5 PM PST, Monday to Friday), which means night shift on your end. Both part-time and full-time spots are open right now, up to 40 hours a week, so tell us what fits your life.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Making calls, qualifying prospects, booking appointments, and keeping everything logged cleanly in our CRM (we run GoHighLevel). You'll follow up on warm leads, chase down no-shows, and flag anything in the process that isn't working so we can fix it together.

Who We're Hoping to Find

Somebody with sharp, confident English, real cold calling experience, and a track record of actually booking appointments, not just dialing numbers. You know how to handle objections without getting flustered, you're comfortable with high call volume, and you've got a reliable setup at home (good internet, headset, quiet space). Whether you're looking for part-time or full-time, we want someone who's in it for the long haul.

If you've called into auto repair or home services before, or have experience with GoHighLevel, US campaigns, or agency/SDR work, that's a big plus, but not required.

What You'll Get

Flexible hours built around your availability, pay tied to your experience and hours committed, and it's paid out in USD through Wise, PayPal, or bank transfer. On top of that, performance bonuses for every appointment you book, rate reviews every 6 months, direct access to the business owners (no layers of management to wade through), and real room to grow as we scale, including a path to full-time if that's what you want. We provide all the tools, including GHL and a dialer.

No drama here. Just a high-performance team that moves fast and takes care of the people who show up for it.

Ready to Apply?

Send over:



Your resume

Quick answers to: why you're a fit, your cold calling/appointment setting background, and whether you're after part-time or full-time

Any proof of past work — call recordings, references, results from previous setter roles

Your expected rate (hourly or monthly, PHP)

A 2-3 minute Loom video covering who you are, your experience, why you want this role, and confirming your availability and ability to work PH night shift



One more thing: at the very top of your application, write the word SYSTEM. Applications missing this won't be reviewed.

Looking forward to meeting you,

Lighthouse Inc.

This is a long term opportunity for the right virtual assistant who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility in the REO space.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. Strong comprehension is needed in this position.

Technical requirements include reliable high speed internet, a quiet home work environment, and proficiency with Google Workspace. Comfort using PDFs, spreadsheets, cloud storage, and task driven systems is required.

title: Short Form Video Editor (Travel Content)
description:
**THIS IS A FREELANCE POSITION, PLEASE READ DESCRIPTION***



My name is Coleman and I run a long form travel channel. I’m looking for a short-form video editor who can help bring that content to life across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This role goes well beyond cutting clips.



I need someone who can watch long-form travel episodes and find the story hiding inside them. That means identifying strong hooks, tension, humor, reveals, and emotional beats, then rebuilding those 
nts into short-form content that stands on its own.



What this role actually looks like:



- Watching long-form episodes and generating 5-10 short-form concepts per video

- Restructuring footage into new narratives rather than summarizing the original

- Finding the comedic, emotional, or curiosity-driven angle that makes someone stop scrolling

- Fully finishing each cut with clean pacing, captions, b-roll, punch-ins, and music

- Pitching ideas proactively, not waiting to be told what to make.



This is a creative collaboration with me. You will be responsible for pitching short form concepts from existing footage. I want someone who brings their own instincts to the footage, not someone who requires all ideas handed to them. 



Creators whose work reflects the style and standard I’m looking for:



Mike Okay, Luke Damant, Harry Jaggard & Small Brained American.



Study how these creators approach short-form content. They find angles in footage that weren’t obvious, use current trends, humor and pacing to hold attention, and understand what makes someone watch to the end and then share it. That’s the mindset I need.



Key skills:

- Proven ability to turn long-form travel content into high-retention short-form videos

- Strong understanding of internet culture and what makes content feel native to each platform

- Ability to write and edit captions in natural, engaging English

- Experience with color correction and audio mixing

- Knowledge of current trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Strong hook instincts, you understand that the first two seconds are everything

title: Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a full-time Content Strategist + Social Media Manager to help drive growth and revenue across Instagram,
, Linkedin and TikTok.



This is not an entry-level social media role, and it is not a “just keep the content calendar full” position.



We are looking for someone who has already helped brands grow and monetize through short vertical video, can clearly explain how they did it, and can step into an established personal brand with both strategy and execution skills.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, 
 and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



Our business includes:



low-ticket offers and live challenges

webinars and launch campaigns

a membership

a flagship course and higher-ticket offers



We are a systems-driven team with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards. We move fast, especially during launch periods, and we are looking for someone who can keep up, think strategically, and execute without needing constant direction.



What This Role Actually Is



This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, conversion strategy, and day-to-day social media execution.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post content.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use content to:



grow the right audience

build trust and authority

support active offers

convert attention into leads and sales

create a repeatable content system the team can execute consistently



You should be able to think like a strategist and work like an operator.



What We Are Looking For



You are likely a fit if the following describes you:



1) You have a real content strategy framework



You do not “wing it” or rely on random content ideas.



You have a repeatable process for:



auditing a brand, its audience, and its offers

identifying what content should drive reach vs trust vs conversion

building content pillars and campaign-specific content plans

turning strategy into hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and content direction

reviewing performance and adjusting based on what the data says



We are not looking for vague “I help brands show up consistently” language.

We want someone who can clearly explain how you build a content strategy that drives business results.



2) You have proof that your work has driven both growth and revenue



We are looking for someone who has helped brands grow accounts and support monetization.



That means you should be able to show:



accounts you have worked on

what the numbers looked like before you got involved

what changed after your strategy was implemented

how your content supported lead generation, launches, offer sales, or conversions



Views and followers are not enough on their own. We care about business impact.



3) You understand short vertical video deeply



You should have strong working knowledge of:



TikTok

 LinkedIn

Instagram Reels

 content strategy



You should understand that content cannot simply be reposted everywhere without thought. We want someone who knows how to think strategically about each platform while still creating a cohesive overall brand content system.



4) You can execute what you strategize



This is not a strategy-only role.



You should be comfortable actually doing the work required to move the strategy forward, including:



developing weekly content direction

writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs

organizing and managing content calendars

scheduling and publishing content

adjusting content during launches and promotions

collaborating with the founder and internal team on what gets created next



5) You are highly organized and proactive



We move quickly. You should be someone who:



meets deadlines without being chased

communicates proactively

can work inside structured systems

can keep multiple moving pieces organized during launch periods

is comfortable collaborating with a founder who is also a strategist

What This Role Involves



Your responsibilities will include:



Deep diving into the Keenya Kelly brand, including audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors

Developing a content strategy based on where the brand is going, not just what has been posted before

Delivering weekly content direction for Instagram, LinkedIn,
, and TikTok

Creating hooks, script direction, captions, and CTAs tied to active offers

Delivering one Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram

Managing day-to-day content execution on the accounts you are directing

Scheduling and publishing content

Building and maintaining a content system the team can use, including:

competitor tracking

content ideas and hook libraries

campaign content planning

content direction frameworks

Joining bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle

Adapting quickly during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaign periods

You Are the Right Fit If…

You have a documented, repeatable process for content strategy

You can show at least 2 examples of accounts you helped grow and monetize

You understand the difference between content for audience growth, authority/trust, and sales

You know how to support a business with multiple offers and live launches

You are comfortable switching between strategy and execution

You can collaborate well with a founder who already understands content strategy

You communicate clearly and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable with deadlines, structure, and accountability

This Is Not the Right Role If…



Please do not apply if any of the following are true:



You are still learning social media strategy and building your process as you go

Your experience is mostly engagement, posting support, or content coordination without measurable strategy results

You cannot clearly explain how your content strategy has supported sales or conversions

You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown

You only want to strategize and do not want to touch execution

You need to fully own every creative decision in order to do your best work

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or organized systems



How to Apply



To be considered, your application must include the following:



1) A brief breakdown of your content strategy framework



We want to understand how you think and how you work.



Please include:



how you approach a new brand from day one

how you d
 what content is for growth vs trust vs conversion

how you build strategy across Instagram,
, and TikTok

how you measure whether content is working



2) Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize



For each example, include:



the brand or account

the platform(s)

what the follower count or performance looked like before you got involved

what strategy you implemented

what changed after

any lead, sales, or revenue results connected to your work



3) Your availability for a full-time role



Please include:



your time zone

your normal working hours

whether you are available to overlap with CST working hours

Important



Applications that are vague, generic, or do not include proof of results will not be reviewed.



We are not looking for someone who simply “loves social media.”

We are looking for someone who knows how to use content to help grow a business.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Hi,



I'm looking for a Virtual Assistant (VA) who can help source content and write scripts for a YouTube channel covering US politics and political debates.



You won't need to edit the videos, as I already have an editor. Your main responsibilities will be:



Find interesting debates, interviews, podcasts, news clips, and political 
nts that have strong viral potential.

Source the original videos and provide accurate timestamps for the clips we can use.

Research the topic and fact-check important claims.

Find supporting articles, tweets, screenshots, and other relevant sources to strengthen the video.

Write an engaging script that combines multiple sources instead of simply summarizing one video.

Suggest interesting topics or debates that are currently trending or have strong viewer appeal.



The script should not rely on a single video. For example, if the topic is Joe Rogan discussing Trump, you would:



Source the original Joe Rogan clip and provide timestamps.

Research the background of the discussion.

Find related news articles, previous interviews, tweets, or public statements.

Watch other relevant debates or podcasts on the same topic.

Combine everything into one well-structured, engaging script with commentary.



I'm looking for someone who has a good understanding of US politics. If you're not already familiar with it, that's completely fine, as long as you're genuinely interested and willing to learn. Strong research skills, curiosity, and the ability to connect information from multiple sources are more important than already knowing everything.



If you're interested, please send me:



Your experience as a Virtual Assistant, researcher, or script writer.

Examples of your work (if available).

Your expected monthly salary or rates.

Your availability and turnaround time.



Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you!

title: Virtual Phone Receptionist
description:

Pay: $5 USD per hour (depending on experience)



Shift Structure



Paid Reception Shift

Friday

* 10:00 PM – 3:00/4:00 AM (Melbourne, Australia time)

* Paid USD $5 per hour

* Plus 5% commission on any booking deposits you secure during your shift.



Commission / On-Call Shifts

These shifts are primarily commission-based.

* Wednesday: 10:00 PM – 3:00/4:00 AM

* Thursday: 10:00 PM – 3:00/4:00 AM

* Sunday: 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM



Commission Structure

* 10% of the booking deposit when you manage the enquiry from start to finish.

* 5% of the booking deposit if you begin the booking and another tea
mber completes it.



POTENTIAL FOR MORE SHIFTS; Paid Saturday & other days with commission. 



About the Role

You will be the first point of contact for clients, answering phone calls and responding to enquiries professionally while following our booking procedures.



Some shifts may be busy with continuous enquiries, while others may be very quiet. Even during quiet periods, you must remain online and available to respond immediately when enquiries come through.



Responsibilities

* Answer incoming phone calls professionally.

* Respond promptly to WhatsApp enquiries.

* Collect client information accurately.

* Follow booking procedures and company systems.

* Keep detailed notes for management.

* Provide exceptional customer service.

* Communicate clearly with the management team.

* Remain organised and calm during busy periods.



Requirements

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Friendly and confident phone manner.

* Previous customer service, receptionist, virtual assistant or call centre experience is preferred.

* Reliable laptop or computer.

* High-speed, stable internet.

* Quiet workspace suitable for phone calls.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Reliable, punctual and trustworthy.



During Every Shift You Must

* Stay logged into WhatsApp on your computer.

* Remain connected to Zoom for communication with management.

* Monitor and refresh WhatsApp regularly for new enquiries.

* Respond to messages and phone calls promptly.

* Remain available for your entire rostered shift, even if there are no enquiries.



This role is reliability-based. Some nights there may be little activity, while other nights can be very busy. You’re being paid (or rostered on commission shifts) to remain available and provide fast, professional responses whenever enquiries come through.



How to Apply

Please send:



* Your resume.

* A short introduction about yourself.

* A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself in English.

* Your internet speed (download and upload).

* Your availability for the listed shifts.



We’re looking for someone who wants a long-term position, takes pride in providing excellent customer service, and can represent our business professionally.

title: Full time video editor for marketing agency
description:
About Chi Media

Chi Media is a full-service marketing agency running social-first content, campaigns, and paid media for a growing portfolio of hospitality, retail, and lifestyle clients. Video is at the center of almost everything we produce, Reels, TikToks, BTS content, ads, and client campaigns and we're looking for a dedicated Video Editor to own that output as our team and client roster grow.

T

he Role

We're hiring a remote Video Editor to take raw footage across a wide range of clients and turn it into polished, on-brand, platform-ready content fast, consistently, and at volume. This is not a purely execution-only role: we want someone with a strong creative eye who can also help shape what we shoot in the first place, not just cut what's handed to them.

Sometimes the videos are in Dutch. You don't need to speak Dutch, but you do need a clear, reliable process for editing it accurately



What You'll Do

• Edit raw footage into polished short-form and long-form content, both mobile and professional for: Reels, TikToks, BTS, and paid ad creative, across multiple client accounts simultaneously

• Edit footage and audio in both English and Dutch, including dialogue, voiceovers, and interviews, using transcripts, translated shotlists, subtitle files, or AI transcription/translation tools to cut and caption accurately without relying on fluency

• Add on-brand captions and burned-in subtitles (Dutch and English), motion graphics, sound design, and pacing suited to each platform

• Pitch shoot concepts, storyboards, and content ideas ahead of shoots, trend-aware angles, formats, and hooks tailored to each client's goals

• Collaborate with account leads on shotlists before shoots so edits are planned in advance, not improvised after the fact

• Manage a high volume of deliverables across 10+ client accounts with overlapping deadlines

• Follow Chi Media's file naming, versioning, and upload conventions so all raw and edited content stays organized and accessible

• Stay current on platform-specific trends and formats across Instagram, TikTok,



What You'll Bring

• Minimum 3+ years experience

• A strong portfolio or demo reel is required we want to see range: mobile, professional content, paid ad creative, interviews, and fast-turnaround social edits

• A track record of pitching creative ideas, not just executing them shoot

concepts, formats, hooks, trends adapted to a brand

• A clear, proven process for editing non-English (ideally including Dutch or another European language) audio content, per above

• Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, and/or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong instincts for pacing, sound design, and trend-aware short-form editing

• Comfortable managing a high volume of deliverables across many clients and deadlines at once

• Reliable, fast turnaround and strong written communication in English

• A stable remote setup high-speed internet, hardware capable of smooth 4K editing, and your own software licenses



Nice to Have

• Prior experience editing content for hospitality, retail, ecom or lifestyle brands

• Experience with AI-assisted transcription/translation workflows for editing non-nativelanguage footage

• Motion graphics or animation skills

• Basic Dutch reading comprehension (not required, but a plus)

title: YouTube Long-Form Editor for an Ex-Pro Gamer Turned Coach. $150-200 Per Video. Ongoing.
description:
I run content for Jaden "Wolfiez" Ashmen. He was one of the best Fortnite players in the world: 2nd place at the 2019 Fortnite World Cup at 15 years old, on a controller. Then he lost it all, rebuilt himself from zero, and now he coaches gamers to level up in real life.



We're building his YouTube channel from the ground up, and I need a long-form editor who actually understands what that means.



This isn't "cut out the silences and add some music." Long-form is storytelling. It's retention. It's the thing that turns a stranger into a believer. Jaden is a natural storyteller: he takes you into the scene, builds the tension, lands the payoff. Your job is to protect that in the edit, not sand it off.



The channel is young. Whoever comes in now helps build the standard, not inherit someone else's template.



**How to apply (read this carefully):**



Applications go through this form only: 



The form includes a required sample edit using footage we provide (the links are on the first page of the form), plus a short Loom walking through your decisions. If you apply without the sample edit, you will not get a reply. That's the filter. It's how we find people who actually want this.



Do not apply through OnlineJobs messages. Form only.



**What you'll edit:**



- YouTube vlogs and talking-head videos (10-20 minutes)

- Story-driven pacing and retention editing, not just cutting clips

- Clean audio, smart B-roll placement, captions, light motion graphics

- Gaming and anime references are native to this brand. If you get that world, you'll love this job.



**What we need from you:**



- You've edited long-form before and can prove it (2-3 full videos required in the application)

- You understand retention and pacing across 10-20 minutes

- Good written English. You reply fast and you don't need chasing.

- Reliable turnaround. If a deadline is at risk, we hear about it before it's missed, not after.



**Pay:** $
per video depending on length and complexity. Ongoing monthly volume.

title: Executive Admin & Full-Charge Bookkeeper (CPA Preferred)
description:
Position: Executive Admin & Full-Charge Bookkeeper

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM US EST (Fixed Shift)

Salary: $1,200 – $1,600 USD (Approx. ?70,000 – ?93,000 PHP) per month, paid semi-monthly



About the Company

We are an established, growing US-based business with a proud 15-year track record of success and a tight-knit team of 14 incredible professionals. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a rockstar Executive Admin and Full-Charge Bookkeeper to join us for the long haul.



We are not looking for a simple data entry clerk—we want a true right-hand partner who can seamlessly manage our administrative workflows, handle contract adjustments, troubleshoot systems, support our leadership, and keep our financial books flawless. If you thrive in a fast-paced, highly detailed, and structured environment, we want to talk to you.



Key Responsibilities

1. Advanced Admin, Contracts & Systems Support

Document & Contract Management: Draft conditional lien releases, prepare contract amendments, modify milestone schedules (such as safe harbor schedules), and update/fix Service Agreements.



Estimates & Quote Preparation: Create custom estimates with specific percentage markups, handle unique pricing requests, and clean up subcontractor quotes (removing identifying names) before sending them to clients.



Systems Administration & IT Troubleshooting: Actively interface with software support teams, manage system password resets (e.g., CRMs/Sunbase), track down missing system
s or scans from spam folders, and source office assets (like voi
 recordings).



Data & Pipeline Maintenance: Routinely track pipeline updates, reassign stale leads/opportunities to sales representatives, and ensure shared project tracking sheets are 100% accurate.



Logistics & Vendor Relations: Coordinate with external vendors, manufacturers, suppliers, or specialized contractors, and interface with building facilities/maintenance when needed.



2. Full-Charge Bookkeeping ,Tax Prep, & Payroll

Core Accounting: Manage accounts payable/receivable, bank and credit card reconciliations, expense categorization, and monthly financial reporting.



Payroll Processing Coordination: Input staff payroll details, commission tracking adjustments, forward final summaries for approval, work directly with our HR Company



Team Coordination: Act as the administrative hub for our 14-person team and ensuring smooth daily operations.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy, Management Accounting, Finance, or a related field is required. Passing the CPA board exam is highly preferred.



Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience working simultaneously as a remote Executive Assistant and Bookkeeper for an established US, UK, or Australian business.



Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Microsoft Excel, and Google Workspace. Experience managing CRM data pipelines is a massive plus.



Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English. You must be completely comfortable and professional when communicating directly with our clients, vendors, and internal team.



Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection (with a documented backup power/internet plan) and a dedicated, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)

We receive a high volume of applications, and extreme attention to detail is critical for this hybrid role. If you do not follow these instructions, your application will be automatically archived.



Please send your application with the exact subject line:

 "Rockstar AE and Accountant found in [Insert Your City/Province]"



In your message, please include:



A brief summary of your remote bookkeeping and executive admin experience supporting a US team.



A link to your resume/CV and your OnlineJobs.ph or LinkedIn profile.



A link to a short (2-4 minute) Loom video introducing yourself. In your video, please answer this: Pick 2 of the specific tasks listed under our "Advanced Admin & Systems" section (e.g., fixing contract milestone schedules, cleaning up vendor quotes, or handling complex payroll adjustments) and briefly explain how you would efficiently handle or troubleshoot them. (Ensure your Loom permissions are set so anyone with the link can view it!)

Confirmation that you are fully available to work the fixed 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM US EST shift.

* AI-powered business operations



What We’re Really Looking For



We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond simple chatbots.



We want someone who can design AI systems that reason through tasks, make decisions within defined workflows, integrate with multiple business systems, and automate real business operations from start to finish.



Our goal is to build AI agents that can reliably perform business tasks 24 hours a day while continuously improving over time.



SHOW US WHAT YOU’VE BUILT

Required Application Questions

Experience

14. Please include links to any of the following:



* Portfolio

* GitHub

* Loom or YouTube demonstrations

* Live applications

* Case studies

* Screenshots

* Architecture diagrams

Final Questions



16. What excites you most about AI agents and workflow automation?

We operate a growing network of YouTube channels across different niches and languages. We are looking for a serious Vibe Coder / AI Engineer / Prompt Engineer to build an internal AI video automation platform from scratch.



This is not a normal developer job. This is not a basic website job. This is not a manual video editing job.



We need someone who can build fast using AI coding tools, connect APIs, test providers, debug issues, and ship a working app quickly.



The goal is simple:

Final video exported without a human editor

The first version does not need to be perfect, but it must work.



The goal is to start producing videos with the app as soon as possible and eventually scale toward 20 videos per day.

Your job is not just to build the app. Your job is also to investigate the cheapest possible workflow that still gives good quality.

ChatGPT

Manus

Copilot

React

APIs

YouTube API

AI image/video generation APIs

TTS tools

Avatar/lip-sync tools

Automation tools



You do not need to know every tool already, but you must learn fast and solve problems independently.



What We Are Looking For



We need someone who:



Can start immediately

Can work full-time

Has strong English communication

Can communicate every day, several times per day

Can send daily updates

Can work fast without disappearing

Timeline

The first MVP should be built in around 2 weeks.



This means you must be able to work full-time and focus deeply on this project.



This is urgent. We are not looking to spend weeks talking without progress.

New workflows

System maintenance

Cost optimization

Scaling the platform

title: SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER

SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER



Every winning ad we run leads somewhere, and that somewhere is the page YOU build. We can have the best creatives in the market, but if the product page is slow, broken, or sloppy, the sale dies on arrival. That's why this role matters as much as it does.



We're hiring a Shopify & GemPages Expert who treats page building like a craft: pixel-accurate duplications, scripts followed to the letter, every app wired up correctly, and zero broken links by the time it reaches us. If you're the kind of builder who can't sleep knowing a button might be misaligned, you're exactly who we want.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Shopify & GemPages Page Building

   You can build product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and full funnel pages inside GemPages. This is your core craft, not something you've dabbled in.



2. Accurate Page & Store Duplication

   You can take any page we show you and duplicate it precisely, across different Shopify stores, without breaking structure or losing detail.



3. Script-Exact Execution

   You follow provided scripts exactly. You place translated text correctly, keep the structure intact, and don't "improve" things we didn't ask you to change.



4. Funnel & Offer Setup

   You know how to set up post-purchase upsells, downsells, bundles, subscriptions, and digital files (ebooks) so the full funnel works end to end.



5. Shopify App Configuration

   You can install and configure the apps that power our funnels, correctly the first time.



6. Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail

   You catch broken links, missing text, untranslated copy, misplaced images, and mobile issues before they ever reach us. Nothing ships half-done.



7. Multi-Market Building

   You've built for German, French, and US audiences and know how to handle translated content properly within each store.



8. Fast Execution

   You work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you take ownership of a task from start to finish.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Core Platform

   - Shopify (store setup, theme customization, policy pages)

   - GemPages (must be expert level, this is the heart of the role)



Upsells, Bundles & Subscriptions

   - OCU for post-purchase upsells and downsells

   - Kaching Bundles for bundle offers

   - Kaching Subscriptions for subscription offers



Digital Products

   - Fileflare (or similar) for ebooks and digital file delivery



Supporting Apps

   - Tracking apps

   - Page builder apps

   - Upsell / cross-sell apps

   - Conversion optimization apps



Collaboration

   - Tools for coordinating with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and ops (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're already fluent in OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions specifically, you move to the top of the list.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Build Pages

   Create product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and funnel pages in GemPages based on the scripts and designs we provide.



2. Duplicate Pages & Stores

   Replicate pages we show you and copy internal pages across different Shopify stores accurately.



3. Place Translated Content

   Build pages for German, French, and US audiences, placing translated text exactly where it belongs based on the provided script.



4. Set Up Offers

   Configure post-purchase upsells and downsells (OCU), bundles (Kaching Bundles), subscriptions (Kaching Subscriptions), and digital files (Fileflare).



5. Configure Apps & Policy Pages

   Install and set up required Shopify apps, plus all policy and support pages: Privacy, Return, Refund, Shipping, Terms, Subscription Policy, Contact, and FAQ.



6. Quality-Check Everything

   Before submitting, verify every link, button, image, text, translation, and integration works, on both mobile and desktop, across the full customer journey.



7. Work With The Team

   Coordinate closely with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and the operations team to keep builds aligned and on time.





QUALITY ASSURANCE STANDARD (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



Before any task is submitted, you must confirm:

   - All links are correct and all buttons work

   - All images are placed correctly, none misplaced

   - No text is missing and nothing is left untranslated

   - All sections are properly aligned

   - Both mobile and desktop versions work

   - All apps are properly integrated

   - All upsells, downsells, bundles, and subscriptions work

   - All digital files / ebooks are properly connected

   - All policy pages are correctly set up

WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - Extensive, expert-level Shopify experience (not basic)

   - Extensive, expert-level GemPages experience

   - Proven, accurate page and store duplication skills

   - Hands-on experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - A strong, reliable quality-control process

   - The ability to follow scripts exactly and work fast without dropping quality

THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You're a Shopify and GemPages expert who can duplicate any page accurately, follow a script to the letter, set up every app correctly, and check everything before submitting. You work fast, you're obsessive about detail, and you take ownership of the final result.





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)
description:
CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)



We're a multi-brand eCommerce company scaling across the German, French, and US markets. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes direct-response advertising, someone who can engineer winning ads, understand exactly how they perform inside the ad account, and keep producing fresh angles that move revenue.



This is not a "make pretty content" role. If you bring fresh ideas, proven results, and the ability to perform under pressure, keep reading.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Winning Ad Research & Reverse-Engineering

   You can dig through spy tools, find ads that are clearly winning, and break down exactly WHY they work. More importantly, you can take that winning angle and build a brand-new original script from it that we can own.



2. Direct-Response Script Writing

   You write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorial pages, and product pages that sell. You understand hooks, angles, emotional triggers, and problem-solution frameworks, not just clever wording.



3. Multi-Market Creative Strategy

   You can write for German, French, and US audiences and make each one feel native. You understand that an angle that crushes in the US might flop in Germany, and you adjust accordingly.



4. Creative-to-Performance Analysis

   You don't just create ads, you read how they perform. You can look at the numbers and know whether the problem is the ad, the offer, the landing page, the audience, or the product.



5. Offer & Angle Development

   You constantly generate new angles, hooks, concepts, and offers. You don't run dry after three ideas.



6. Working Under Pressure

   You make fast, data-driven decisions when revenue is on the line and you don't fold when performance drops.



7. Full Funnel Understanding

   You understand the entire Shopify dropshipping process, from the ad, to the product page, to checkout, so your creatives align with the whole buyer journey.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Spy & Research Tools

   - Gethookd (must be expert level)

   - Kalodata (must be expert level)

   - Plus any similar ad spy and winning-product research tools you bring to the table



Advertising & Analytics

   - Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager (for reading campaign performance)



Store & Funnel

   - Shopify (core platform for our stores and product pages)



Collaboration & Briefing

   - Tools for writing creative briefs and coordinating with editors and designers (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're an expert in Gethookd and Kalodata specifically, you move to the top of the list. If you bring other strong spy tools we don't use yet, even better. We want someone who improves our stack, not just fits into it.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Research & Intelligence

   Use spy tools daily to find winning ads and products, study why they work, and feed that intel into our creative pipeline.



2. Script & Concept Creation

   Write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages across the German, French, and US markets.



3. Angle Development

   Take winning ads, reverse-engineer the angle, and turn them into fresh, original concepts we can run as our own.



4. Performance Review

   Work alongside our media buyers, review ad performance, and identify which creatives to kill, improve, or scale.



5. Troubleshooting & Turnarounds

   When a product or campaign is underperforming, diagnose the real cause and propose new creative angles, offers, or page improvements to turn it around.



6. Briefing the Team

   Write clear, detailed creative briefs for our video editors and graphic designers so execution matches your strategy.



7. Bringing New Strategies

   Continuously introduce fresh techniques, testing ideas, and creative strategies that keep us ahead of competitors.





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - A proven track record with real results and achievements you can show us, not just talk about

   - Expert-level skill with spy tools, especially Gethookd and Kalodata

   - Expert script writing for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages

   - The ability to analyze a winning ad's angle and build a fresh script from it

   - Extensive experience writing scripts for German, French, and US audiences

   - A solid understanding of the full Shopify dropshipping business process

   - The ability to handle pressure and make fast, data-driven decisions

   - Strong direct-response instincts and a deep grasp of customer psychology





NICE TO HAVE



   - Hands-on Meta Ads media buying experience

   - Experience turning around declining products or campaigns

   - UGC, podcast ad, and native ad scripting experience





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You think in angles and hooks, not just visuals. You get excited reverse-engineering a competitor's winner. You can write for three very different markets and make each one feel native. And when performance drops, you don't panic, you diagnose.



If that's you, apply and show us your best work.

title: Graphic Designer / Creative Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Graphic Designer/Creative Engineer. The kind of person who can take design off the founder's plate entirely and push the brand's look somewhere better than he could take it himself.



You'll own the visual layer of a growing consumer brand end to end: main images, Amazon A+ content, the Shopify catalogue, ad and listing videos, the Brand Store, packaging. Everything a customer sees before they buy. You'll run image split tests to find what actually converts, render concepts for new products, and use AI to move faster on all of it. You'll have full access to Claude and whatever comes next.



This isn't a production-artist role where you wait for briefs. It's a design role with taste and real ownership. If you already make excellent work with minimal direction, and you want more autonomy, smarter tools, and a founder who'll get out of your way once you've earned it, read on.





YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You make genuinely excellent, tasteful work with minimal direction. Your portfolio shows clean, modern, typographically literate design that would raise the bar on a brand, made without a creative director standing over you. This is the one thing we care about most.

You're an expert retoucher. Clean cutouts, correct colour, and sharp product images are second nature, not a stretch.

You can edit video end to end: cut, sound, thumbnail, export. Ad and listing content, not just stills.

You're AI-fluent (the Creative Engineer aspect). You actively use AI image and video tools in your daily work and you're always hunting the next one. Comfortable with prompting for product and environment shots.

You have a real eye for what sells online. You think about the customer looking at a listing, not just the composition.

You know Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma inside out.

Your written and spoken English is good enough to work async and take feedback cleanly.



DON'T APPLY IF



Your work is competent but generic, or only good when someone else art-directs it

You need a detailed brief to produce something good. Minimal direction is how we work

You treat AI as "something to dabble with" rather than core to how you work

You only do stills and can't or won't edit video

You don't much care whether the thing you made actually sells



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Own the visual layer



Design and refine main images across all marketplaces, to a standard that beats what sits next to us in search

Build and update Amazon A+ content, including translated versions across our international marketplaces (US, CA, MX, UK, AU, JP)

Rebuild and elevate the Shopify catalogue

Expert retouching across the catalogue



Cut the video



Edit UGC into ad and listing videos: choose the 
nts, optimise sound, export, make thumbnails, and hand to our Operations Manager for upload

Build workflows for AI-generated and AI-enhanced video



Find what converts



Run main image split tests in sync with marketing

Test main images against competitors to find winners (our Build it Backwards process)

Build and run polls, and tell us what the results actually say



Design the brand



Brand Store, product packaging, stickers, inserts

Hold the brand's visual identity as it scales



Help build the products



Render product and packaging concepts for new products and put them to polling

Teardown competitor products and listings to find where we can win

Bring product ideas, not just execution



BONUS SKILLS (NICE, NOT REQUIRED)



A real feel for International Typographic/Swiss Style and Dutch design. Our brand leans on it, so if this means something to you, tell us

Motion graphics or After Effects

3D or product rendering

Experience designing for Amazon and Shopify brands specifically



WHERE YOU FIT



You report directly to the founder to start

You'll work closely with the founder on the look and direction until we hire a Marketing/Growth Manager. Once they're in place, you report to them

You'll hand finished images and video to our Operations Manager for upload

Our Supply Manager will occasionally ask you for product design files



BENEFITS



US $1,800 to $2,000/month

Annual performance review with discretionary bonus tied to KPI delivery

40 hours/week, flexible schedule. Most of the work isn't time-sensitive, so you manage your own hours with a couple of hours of AEST/AEDT overlap for feedback

Work from anywhere in the world

We provide the Adobe Creative Cloud/Figma access; you bring a capable machine and a colour-accurate monitor

3-month probation; long-term engagement thereafter

Direct line to the founder and a real seat at the table as we grow

Job security: we've been in e-commerce since 2017 and we're hiring because we're scaling, not because something broke



TO APPLY



Please complete our application form here:

We are building a custom WooCommerce-based funnel system that goes far beyond normal WordPress or ecommerce setups.



This is NOT a website building job.



This is NOT a plugin configuration job.



If that’s your skill set, stop reading here.



---



## ???? What this actually is



We are building a multi-step checkout system with conditional logic, where:



- users choose between different purchase paths

- flows change based on selections

- cart state updates dynamically across steps

- checkout reflects structured data, not just products

- WooCommerce is being extended, not used “as-is”



This is a system build, not a page build.



---



## ? This is NOT for you if:



- you only build WordPress pages or themes

- you rely on plugins to “make things work”

- you don’t understand WooCommerce hooks or cart behavior

- you think of checkout as a static page

- you need step-by-step instructions to figure out system logic



This will frustrate you and waste your time.



---



## ? This IS for you if:



- you understand WooCommerce at a structural level

- you think in systems, not pages

- you can trace what happens to data from click ? cart ? checkout ? order

- you are comfortable working with logic, not templates

- you can identify where systems break before they break



---



# ???? First Step (Required — Paid if completed correctly)



We use a different hiring process.



Instead of interviews, we evaluate real thinking.



You will be given a real funnel scenario (Alpha One system).



You must:



### 1. Go through the full funnel (pages 1–checkout)



### 2. Break down your thinking:

For each step, explain:



- What is the user doing?

- What is happening in the system?

- What changes in the cart or state?

- What do you believe must exist in WooCommerce to support this?



### 3. Generate your own logic:



You must also identify:



- what questions YOU would ask if you were building this

- where the system might break

- what is unclear or missing in the flow



---



## ?? Important



There are no provided questions.



You must generate the structure yourself.



We are not testing memorization.



We are testing whether you can reconstruct system logic from UI flow.



---



## ???? Allowed formats



You may respond using:



- written explanation

- step-by-step breakdown

- or simple flowchart format



Clarity matters more than format.



---



## ???? Compensation



This first test may be compensated ($3–$7 equivalent) if completed fully and correctly.



Incomplete submissions are not evaluated.



---



## ???? What happens next



Strong submissions will be moved into:



- deeper WooCommerce implementation tests

- real build environments

- production-level funnel work



This is a working system role, not a discussion role.



---



## ???? Final note



This is a high-clarity role.



It may be simple for the right person.



It will be confusing for the wrong one.



That is intentional.

title: Youtube Thumbnail Artist - AI Image Generation
description:
We run a network of YouTube channels across several niches : history, military, firearms, men's lifestyle & advice, farming/homesteading — doing millions of views per month. We're hiring ONE full-time thumbnail designer.



The job:



A thumbnail exists for ONE reason: to make a stranger stop scrolling and click. That is thumbnail psychology, and it is the entire job. AI image skills WITHOUT thumbnail psychology are worthless to us — a beautiful image nobody clicks is a wasted image and wasted money.



1. Start with psychology, not pixels: from our brief, lock the focal point, the emotion, and the curiosity gap. The reason a viewer HAS to click

2. Generate the base image with AI (we provide the accounts and image-gen budget) through deliberate, iterative prompting. Every prompt decision made in service of the click, not of "looking cool"

3. Finish in Photoshop or Canva: fix artifacts, composite, color grade, add text that reads at mobile size - judged by one question only: does this make more people click?



If you think of thumbnails as art, do not apply. If you understand that a thumbnail is click psychology rendered as an image, keep reading.



**You're the right person if:**



- You already work with AI image tools (GPT 2, Nanobanana 2 experience is a must) and can show your work WITH the prompts. Personal projects and fan thumbnails count — client work is NOT required

- You have visual taste: you can look at two thumbnails and explain why one gets clicked and the other gets scrolled past

- You know Photoshop, or you're strong in Canva and willing to learn Photoshop fast

- You apply feedback ONCE — we tell you something, you never make that mistake again

- You want one stable long-term employer, not gig work

- Be willing to work late at night to match with my timezone



**What you get:**



- 400$/month starting salary - View bonuses WILL be added if your performance leads to results

- Reviews at 3, 6, and 12 months — strong performers reach ?30,000+ within the first year

- AI Image credits provided

- Full-time, long-term. 



**Content note:** some of our channels cover military history and firearms in an educational/historical context. You must be comfortable designing thumbnails featuring weapons and war imagery.



**HOW TO APPLY — we delete applications that skip any step:**



1. Your subject line must begin with: **MAGENTA FALCON**

2. Attach your 3 best thumbnails — real client work, redesigns of existing videos, or fan thumbnails all count

3. Attach 2 AI-generated images along with the FULL prompt(s) you used for each, including your iterations

4. Look at the thumbnail on this video: 
. In 3–4 sentences: what's working, what's failing, what would you change?

5. Confirm your earliest start date



Generic or copy-pasted applications missing any of these 5 items will not be read.

title: Online ESL Teacher
description:
1. Provide one-on-one online English lessons for students with official course materials and standardized teaching procedures. Teach entirely in English and build an immersive learning environment.



2. Interact actively with students, encourage oral output, and correct pronunciation, grammar and expression errors. Adjust teaching speed and difficulty according to students’ English level.



3. Check internet, camera and microphone before every class. Ensure stable connection, clear audio and video. Be punctual for all scheduled classes. No unexcused absences, lags or class cancellations.



4. Submit complete and accurate class reports after each lesson, record students’ performance, strengths and weaknesses, and cooperate with the team to track students’ learning progress.



5. Follow all platform rules, dress codes and teaching disciplines, and maintain a professional teaching image during working hours.



6. Participate in regular teacher training and teaching evaluations to continuously improve class quality and student experience.

title: Operations & Marketing Coordinator

We have transformed 50,000+ lives, sold out 35 live events globally, and are now launching our certification program and international world tour. 



We move fast, we do big things, and we need the right person to run operations behind the scenes so our founder can focus on growth.



This is a full-time, long-term role. We hire for keeps.

Growth & Scaling

Set up and maintain automations across GHL,
, and social platforms

Constantly look for smarter, faster, better ways to do things — and implement them

Manage GHL CRM — contacts, pipelines, automations, and lead tracking

Onboard new clients into our certification and mentorship programs

Draft
s and communications on behalf of the founder

s, and ads

Maintain brand consistency across all platforms (black, gold, white)

Manage and organise the content library



Events & World Tour

Social Media



Schedule and post content on Instagram and

Track masterclass funnel performance and report weekly





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Experience building and optimising sales funnels and automation systems

Expert-level AI skills — especially Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork

title: ECOMMERCE FINANCE, P&L & AUTOMATION MANAGER
description:
ECOMMERCE FINANCE, P&L & AUTOMATION MANAGER



We are looking for an experienced Ecommerce Finance, P&L & Automation Manager to manage, improve, and automate our daily, weekly, and monthly financial reporting across all stores, brands, and products.



This is not just a basic bookkeeping role.



We need someone who can give management clear visibility into the financial health of the entire company every day, while also helping automate the reporting process so we can reduce manual work, avoid missing expenses, and make faster business decisions.



Responsibilities



* Update and maintain the company’s Daily P&L sheet

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly P&L reports

* Track revenue across all stores and products

* Track COGS across all stores and products

* Track ad spend across all advertising platforms

* Track refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and payment processor fees

* Track app costs, subscriptions, software, tools, and recurring expenses

* Track salaries, contractor payments, and team-related costs

* Track fulfillment costs, shipping costs, and operational expenses

* Track profit and loss by store, product, and brand

* Monitor overall company cash flow

* Identify which stores and products are profitable

* Identify which stores, products, or expenses need management attention

* Create clear reports showing daily, weekly, and monthly company performance

* Make sure all financial data is accurate, complete, and updated on time

* Work with the operations team, media buyers, customer service team, and management to collect missing data

* Improve and organize the company’s P&L reporting system



Automation Requirement



We strongly prefer someone who has experience automating ecommerce financial reporting.



The ideal candidate should be able to help automate the process of pulling, organizing, and reporting financial data from different sources such as:



* Shopify

* Meta Ads

* Google Ads

* PayPal

* Stripe

* Klarna

* Payment processors

* Fulfillment providers

* App subscriptions

* Contractor and salary records

* Refund and chargeback reports

* Google Sheets or Excel dashboards



We want someone who can help build a system where daily, weekly, and monthly P&L reporting becomes faster, cleaner, and more accurate.



Preferred Automation Skills



* Google Sheets automation

* Excel automation

* Google Apps Script

* API integrations

* Zapier

* Make

* Looker Studio

* Dashboard building

* Automated data pulling

* Automated financial reporting

* Ecommerce reporting workflows



Proof Required



Applicants with proof of previous automation work will be prioritized.



Please provide examples of financial reports, dashboards, P&L sheets, or automated reporting systems you have built before.



We want to see real examples showing that you have successfully automated similar finance, ecommerce, or reporting work in the past.



What We Need To See



* Daily company cash flow

* Daily profit or loss

* Weekly profit or loss

* Monthly profit or loss

* Profitability by store

* Profitability by product

* Revenue by store and product

* Ad spend by store and product

* Refunds and chargebacks by store and product

* COGS by store and product

* Fixed expenses

* Variable expenses

* App and subscription costs

* Salary and contractor costs

* Areas losing money

* Areas performing well

* Biggest assets of the company

* Areas that need immediate attention



Requirements



* Strong experience with P&L reporting

* Strong understanding of ecommerce financial reporting

* Experience working with Shopify stores

* Experience tracking revenue, COGS, refunds, chargebacks, ad spend, and expenses

* Experience automating reports or dashboards

* Experience with Google Sheets or Excel

* Strong attention to detail

* Strong analytical skills

* Ability to work with daily deadlines

* Ability to organize messy financial data

* Ability to create clear reports for management

* Ability to identify financial problems and opportunities

* Good communication skills

* Reliable, accurate, and consistent



Preferred Experience



* Experience with ecommerce or dropshipping businesses

* Experience with multiple stores or multiple brands

* Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, and payment processors

* Experience with cash flow reporting

* Experience with bookkeeping or financial controlling

* Experience creating automated dashboards or automated reports

* Experience connecting multiple data sources into one reporting system



This Role Is For You If



* You are very detail-oriented

* You enjoy working with numbers

* You can update financial reports daily

* You can spot missing expenses or incorrect data

* You can automate repetitive reporting tasks

* You understand that small errors can affect company decisions

* You can clearly explain whether the company is profitable or losing money

* You can help management understand where money is being made and where money is being lost



This Role Is NOT For You If



* You only want to do basic bookkeeping

* You cannot work with daily reporting deadlines

* You have no experience with ecommerce financial reporting

* You have no experience automating reports or dashboards

* You are not comfortable handling multiple stores, products, and expense categories

To Apply



Please send:

* Your experience with P&L reporting

* Examples of financial reports, dashboards, or P&L sheets you have created

title: Lifestyle Manager at a Fast-Growing AI Startup
description:
If you’ve spent your career managing the personal world of a high-profile executive, VIP guests at a 5-star location, or high-net-worth clients at a luxury brand, you speak & write fluent English, and you know how to turn a good experience into an unforgettable one, this role is for you. Apply here: 



Overview:

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. Think of it as the operating system for someone’s entire personal life, travel, dining, exclusive experiences, luxury goods, and wellness all managed in one place by a team that genuinely goes the extra mile. 



This is a role with a real growth path. If you want to grow into a leadership position, not just do a job, strong performers here will be the first in line to step up as the team scales.



What This Role Actually Looks Like

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.



IMPORTANT: Please carefully read the responsibilities section below to ensure you’re a good fit, and follow the instructions on how to apply at the bottom



Compensation:

*Competitive salary: $1,400 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)



Benefits:

PTO, Wellbeing Stipend, Growth path into a leadership role

Working Hours:

*Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

*This is a full-time role only (40 hours per week)



Core Responsibilities:

* Take a member’s confirmed plans and elevate them, coordinating room amenities, securing hard-to-get reservations, arranging private access, and adding personal touches that make the experience extraordinary.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

* Build and maintain genuine relationships with our partner network so that we get access, prioritisation, and goodwill that others don’t.

* Communicate with members clearly and precisely in writing and on calls, keeping them updated at every step with the right details at the right time.

* Work alongside our internal AI tools to research, draft, and refine recommendations applying your own judgment to every output before it reaches a member.

* Document member preferences, request history, and partner interactions in our systems every time, without being reminded.

* Grow into a leadership position as the department scales. Strong performers will take on increasing ownership of the Lifestyle Manager function.



You’re Perfect for This Role If You

*Have 3+ years in a high-touch, client-facing role serving wealthy or high-profile principals - whether as a personal or executive assistant to a CEO, a VIP or guest relations manager at a five-star location (e.g. The Peninsula Manila, Shangri-La, Solaire, Raffles), or a client relations manager at a luxury brand (e.g. LVMH, Richemont, Rustan’s).

*Speak and write English at a native level. Clear, confident, and polished whether you’re messaging a member or calling a hotel manager in New York or London.

*Have a phone manner that gets results and you’re not rattled by gatekeepers, you know who to ask for, and “fully booked” is never where the conversation ends.

*Have genuine finesse, warm and reassuring with members, direct and effective with partners, and composed under pressure when things don’t go to plan.

*Take full ownership of every request. You follow through without being chased, spot problems before they surface, and never leave something half-done.

*Are comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, using them to move faster and produce better work, while knowing when your own judgment needs to take over.



Nice to Have:

*Personal familiarity with luxury properties, restaurants, and experiences in NYC, London, Paris, Dubai, Tokyo, or Singapore.

*An existing personal network of contacts at high-end hospitality venues or luxury lifestyle providers.

*Prior experience working with international or foreign employers.

title: Community Builder (for founders and CEOs)
description:
We're launching a founder-facing peer community on Circle, built around *The Breakout CEO* podcast and the Intellectual Strategies brand. This community is a professional network — not a fan club. It exists to warm potential clients, generate referrals, and surface guests, while giving members genuine peer value.



This role owns the community from the ground up: platform setup, founding member recruitment, weekly engagement, growth, health reporting, and the podcast newsletter. You'll work closely with the Marketing Operations Lead, who owns editorial direction across the broader content engine.



**This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction. It's a role for someone who knows how to build and sustain engagement with sophisticated professionals — and can prove it.**



ABOUT US

Intellectual Strategies is a U.S.-based fractional legal team helping innovators and scaling CEOs align legal and business strategy. Our founder, Jeff Holman, also hosts *The Breakout CEO* — a podcast featuring candid conversations with growth-stage leaders in SaaS, eCommerce, and tech.



Our audience is startup founders and scaling CEOs running businesses in the $1M–$50M+ range. We're building a professional peer community to serve that audience — and we're looking for someone to build and run it.



What You'll Own

Community

- Launch and ongoing management of the podcast-centric community on Circle

- New member onboarding and welcome experience — welcome sequence, orientation, first action prompt

- Weekly engagement calendar — discussion prompts, episode threads, member spotlights, polls, Q&As, and AMAs

- Community guidelines, culture standards, and moderation

- Founding member recruitment and VIP onboarding (starting with past podcast guests)

- Identify and cultivate power members — recognize them publicly, give them elevated roles

- Community growth and health reporting (monthly)

Podcast Newsletter

- Own the podcast newsletter end-to-end — editorial direction, writing, and consistent send schedule

- Content reflects community conversations, episode highlights, member wins, and relevant resources for startup founders and scaling CEOs

- Voice is professional, direct, and substantive — written for founders making high-stakes decisions, not a coaching or wellness audience

- Surfaces community highlights and member content to the MOL for cross-channel use

LinkedIn Podcast Page

- Monitor and respond to comments on The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page — same audience, same voice, same relationship-building instinct as the community itself

- Scope may expand over time to include The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page more broadly, including coordination on post finalization and scheduling, as the team evolves



Possible Role Expansion

- As the podcast community stabilizes, this role will assist the Marketing Ops Lead in scoping and eventually launching a law firm community and supporting community-facing elements of the Breakout CEO Awards program. Neither is a current priority.

- LinkedIn responsibilities may also grow as the team evolves, potentially including broader involvement in social content finalization and distribution for the podcast brand.



What You Won't Own (other tea
mbers handle these responsibilities)

- Law firm blog or law firm newsletter 

- Podcast production, editing, or episode publication

- GHL, 
, or marketing automation 

- Podcast guest pipeline outreach and booking



Experience with Circle is a strong advantage. Familiarity with dedicated community platforms (Slack, Skool, etc.) is acceptable if you haven't used Circle specifically.



Who We're Looking For

**Must have:**

- Demonstrated community growth — not just management, but documented member growth and engagement results

- Ability to work independently without daily direction; client testimony or portfolio evidence required

- Strong enough writing to own the podcast newsletter independently — clear, direct, and credible for a professional founder audience

- Understands community as a business function, not just a gathering place

- Can adapt voice and engagement style to startup founders and scaling CEOs



This role is inherently relationship-driven work. You genuinely enjoy facilitating other people's conversations — not just broadcasting content. You find meaning in member connections and community health, not just follower counts. You're warm, consistent, and patient. If community work feels draining rather than energizing, this isn't the right fit.

Preferred

- Experience with B2B, professional services, or founder-facing communities

- Platform experience with Circle, Slack, or other dedicated community tools

- Podcast community experience

- Familiarity with community-to-pipeline connection (how community members become clients or referrals)



**This role is not a fit if:**

- Your entire portfolio is consumer wellness, coaching, or MLM-adjacent communities with no evidence of B2B adaptation

- You frame community as "creating a safe space" rather than driving business outcomes

- You can't produce specific engagement or growth metrics from past work

- You require constant content direction from the principal



The Audience Test

Our community members are startup founders and scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. The tone that works for a coaching community, a wellness brand, or a consumer audience will not work here. Every candidate must pass a short writing test before any interview is scheduled.



*Draft a brief three-paragraph newsletter intro for a podcast that features candid conversations with scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. Topic: CEOs who are navigating pivotal decisions usually align with a "Breakout Arc" that includes the following stages: Building traction, something Breaks and disrupts the 
ntum, new perspectives and actions lead to a Breakout 
nt, the business achieves a new breakthrough trajectory



Use whatever tools you want, including AI. Your job is to make sure the final result sounds nothing like AI (e.g., no generic openers, no motivational filler, no hedged corporate phrasing, no bullet-pointed "key takeaways.") It should read like a sharp, specific human wrote it for our specific audience.



What we're evaluating: Does the voice fit founders making high-stakes decisions? Is it clear, direct, and earned? Or does it sound like it came from a template? The writing doesn't need to be perfect. It needs to show the right instincts and the judgment to know what "right" sounds like for this audience.



**Submit the writing test with your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.**



To Apply



Submit the following:

1. Your writing test (see above — required)

2. A brief overview of 1–2 communities you've built or grown, with specific results (member count growth, engagement metrics, outcomes); make sure to emphasize the building, as we need to launch our community

3. Any relevant portfolio links or client testimonials



**Applications without the writing test will not be reviewed.**

title: SENIOR FULL-STACK DEVELOPER for EdTech SaaS (Long-Term Lead Role)
description:
